# MakeHuman core assets used by guard V4

The independent camp treasury guard prototype uses CC0 1.0 core assets from the MakeHuman Community. See LICENSE.ASSETS.md for the upstream asset license and sources.json for exact source URLs, selected files and SHA256 hashes. No MakeHuman code or runtime is embedded.

Derived resource: resources/prototypes/camp_treasury_3d/guard.glb. Godot may extract its four embedded MakeHuman textures beside the GLB during import. The original assets and local upgrade script are retained under art/candidates/camp-treasury-3d-v1/source/makehuman and upgrade_guard_v4.py.

Original creators are identified in the source file headers and the upstream license. User-provided costume reference is separate and is not part of these CC0 assets.
